living_document.purpose: This JSON is designed to be continuously extended. Add new fields without breaking existing ones. Prefer additive changes and version bumps.
extension_rules: Do not rename or delete existing keys unless absolutely necessary; deprecate instead.
When adding a new capability, append a new object under `extensions` and reference it from the relevant phase/command.
When changing behavior, update `history` with a short entry and bump `spec_version` (patch for clarifications, minor for new features, major for breaking changes).
Use stable IDs for phases/commands/stores so agents can reference them reliably.

how_to_add_details.new_phase: Add an object under `pipeline.phases[]` and update `pipeline.state_machine.transitions` if it introduces new statuses.
how_to_add_details.new_command: Add an object under `cli.commands[]` and reference it from phases that use it.
how_to_add_details.new_datastore: Add a new store under `persistence.stores` and document schema under `persistence.schemas`.

history.change: Initial JSON living spec created from RAW workflow.

glossary.family: Product family identifier (e.g., Aspose.ZIP) used to resolve configs, DLLs, repos, samples, API refs.
glossary.example: A code snippet extracted from Markdown (inline fenced code or referenced via Gist).
glossary.inline_example: Example stored directly in Markdown code fences.
glossary.gist_example: Example referenced via a Gist embed or metadata; code may be fetched and later replaced by uploading a new Gist.
glossary.product_dll: Latest DLL (or assembly set) used to compile and validate examples.
glossary.example_repo: GitHub repository that holds sample data and/or existing examples used for backfill and guidance.
glossary.vector_db: Embeddings store containing existing examples for similarity retrieval during runtime fixes.

mode.description: Choose whether scanning is based on a directory path or a family config.

directory_path.description: Required when mode=directory. Root directory to scan for .md files.

family.description: Required when mode=family. Used to resolve content roots from config.

provider.description: Must support switching to any OpenAI-supported model via config.

model.description: OpenAI-supported model name; can be overridden per command/phase.

commit_description_template.default: Updated verified examples (compile+runtime) and refreshed inline/gist embeds. RunId={run_id}

runner.description: Command or runner id used to execute examples.

scenario_selector.description: Rule/strategy to pick appropriate sample/scenario for an example.

phases.name: Discovery and Extraction
steps: Scan for *.md files in the scope.
Extract inline fenced code examples.
Extract gist references and resolve gist metadata needed to fetch code.
Normalize each example into a canonical record (stable example_id).
acceptance_criteria: All discovered examples have example_id, file_path, source_type, and original_code.
Extraction preserves location metadata to support safe replacement.

phases.name: Compilation Verification Loop
steps: Compile/validate each example against latest product DLL.
If compile fails: build LLM fix payload (code + compiler logs + API refs + scaffolding context).
Send payload to LLM to produce corrected code.
Recompile corrected code; repeat until success or attempts exhausted.
On success: persist original->compilable mapping and mark status COMPILABLE.
acceptance_criteria: Compilation succeeds with the configured build target.
Compiler logs are persisted as evidence for each attempt.
Database updated with compilable_code and status.

phases.name: Runtime Verification Loop
steps: Ensure test data exists locally at test-data/{family}; if missing and configured, download from example_repo.
Execute code using runtime runner + scenario selector; capture logs and environment details.
If runtime fails: ensure vector DB has existing examples; backfill from example_repo if needed.
Build LLM runtime fix payload (code + runtime logs + scenario + retrieved similar examples).
Send payload to LLM to produce corrected code.
Re-run corrected code with the same scenario; repeat until success or attempts exhausted.
On success: persist verified_code and mark status VERIFIED.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime completes without exceptions for the selected scenario.
Runtime evidence (logs, sample used, environment, DLL version) is persisted.

phases.name: Markdown Update (Inline/Gist)
steps: For inline examples: replace fenced code block with verified code (preserve fences + language).
For gist examples: upload verified code to designated gist account and replace gist embed metadata in .md.
Ensure only intended blocks are replaced using location metadata (no accidental edits).
acceptance_criteria: Markdown remains valid; fences are correct; gist embeds reference the new gist id/hash and filename.
Diffs are generated and stored per file.

phases.name: Final LLM Review of Updated Markdown
steps: Send full updated .md to LLM for relevance check and correctness of snippet injection.
If review fails: apply configured remediation path (auto-fix or manual gate) and optionally re-review.
acceptance_criteria: LLM confirms code relevance to topic and correct injection format.
Any required edits are applied and tracked.

phases.name: Persist, Telemetry, Commit
steps: Update database final status and persist finalized artifacts.
Write internal telemetry and local-telemetry records for the run.
Commit only touched files with configurable message/description templates (if git enabled).
Store commit hash in database/telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Database status indicates COMMITTED (when git enabled) or FINAL_REVIEW_PASSED (when git disabled).
Telemetry includes run_id, durations per phase, attempt counts, and resource decisions.

requirements: Operations must be provided through cmdlets/commands.
All operations must be independently executable (standalone).

commands.name: Extract Examples
commands.description: Extract inline and gist examples; normalize into records.

commands.name: LLM Fix Compilation Errors
commands.description: LLM-based correction loop for compilation failures.

commands.name: Runtime Verify
commands.description: Execute examples against samples and capture runtime results.

commands.name: LLM Fix Runtime Errors
commands.description: LLM-based correction loop for runtime failures with retrieval of similar examples.

commands.name: Update Markdown
commands.description: Replace inline code fences or gist references with verified code.

commands.name: Final LLM Review
commands.description: Validate relevance and correctness of code injection in Markdown.

commands.name: Commit Changes
commands.description: Commit only touched files with configurable commit message/description.

commands.name: Backfill Context
commands.description: Fetch missing samples/examples/API refs as required for LLM consumption.

requirements: Persistent databases must be maintained and properly organized.
Backfill must be available for all information needed for LLMs to consume.

relational_db.purpose: Source of truth for example records, statuses, mappings, runs, artifacts metadata.

vector_db.purpose: Embeddings store for existing examples used as guidance during runtime fixes.

artifact_store.purpose: Stores logs, request/response payloads, diffs, and run evidence files.

local_telemetry.purpose: Durable run logs and metrics for auditability and reporting.

backfill.principle: If an LLM-required context is missing, system must be able to backfill automatically or via a dedicated command.

model_switching.requirement: All LLM calls must be routed through a single LLM adapter layer that supports switching to any OpenAI-supported model via config.

markdown_edit_safety: Replace only by recorded location metadata; never broad regex over entire file unless explicitly configured.
Preserve fences and language tags for inline code.
For gist replacement, update only gist owner/id/filename fields and keep surrounding markdown intact.
reproducibility: Persist DLL version used for validation.
Persist sample identifier and scenario used for runtime verification.

multi_language_examples.notes: Add support for multiple languages/frameworks per family.

manual_approval_gates.notes: Add optional human approval before MD update or before commit.

parallel_execution.notes: Add concurrency controls and scheduling for large repos.
